scope: Node worker_threads running identified deployed Pages code; not browser timing

configuration.fresh: A fresh pool/analyzer for every sample, matching the UI lifetime; outerWallMs includes their construction
configuration.warm: 2 Workers, initial call separate, then repeated calls in the same pool

normalization.scope: Cross-version comparison only; absent after remains null. Raw semanticSha256 and actual versions are preserved separately. No ruleSetVersion, functional value, path or hash is excluded or normalized.

comparison.reason: Caller elapsed includes final report validation/freeze and fresh pool construction; report.metrics.totalMs excludes final validation/freeze.

batch.scope: Fresh pool, moduleReuse=false, per-condition median of 5; proposed implementation acceptance criteria, not user-stated requirements.

moduleReuse.scope: Single-snapshot analyze(); no inference about compare() or general browsers.

moduleReuse.reason: 10% criterion not met consistently; Instance isolation retained.

memory.reason: Simplify ZIP output ownership while preserving CRC/path/length/full-inventory checks. Observed RSS difference is too small for a reliable peak-reduction claim.

memory.interpretation: Every case has a fresh Node process. Fixture creation occurs in the parent before sampling. At/below limit requires complete opaque inventory/hash preservation; above limit requires an explicit limit error. Sampled memory is not a browser measurement or a memory ceiling.

limitations: Synthetic single-snapshot analyze() measurements using Node worker_threads, not browser timings or general Unity-project speed guarantees.
Fresh pool lifetime and default moduleReuse match the UI; browser scheduling/GC still differ.
Repeated conditions are sequential, not a randomized cross-over experiment; retain observed ranges and avoid causal precision beyond the measured fixtures.
Job stage sums can overlap and nested intervals must not be summed into wall time. startupMs includes module import, scheduling and delivery, not only OS thread creation.
Observed RSS covers the Node process including Workers; heap/external/arrayBuffers cover the main isolate. Samples can miss transient peaks and there is no forced GC or leak conclusion.

The first candidate run completed sampling but failed final cross-version comparison before printing samples. stderr is preserved; corrected run retains raw versions/hashes and normalizes only before/after.analyzerVersion for semantic comparison.
